description:
Get USGS daily values (daily means of the continuous record) for trend analysis.
Unlike real-time readings, these are one value per day — better for multi-month or multi-year trends.
Parameter codes: 00060=discharge (cfs), 00065=gage height (ft), 00010=water temp (°C).
With only state_cd, returns every site in the state (keep the window short).

state_cd.description: State (code, name, or FIPS) — all sites in the state when sites is omitted

name: usgs_daily_water_data
